title: Which hotel brands are you most familiar with?
area: Orlando area: hotels within about 30 miles of downtown Orlando, which covers Walt Disney World, Lake Buena Vista, Kissimmee, Celebration, International Drive, the airport, Winter Park, Altamonte Springs, Lake Mary and Sanford.
method: Each brand is listed only if an official brand directory or official property page shows an open Orlando-area hotel, as of Oct 31, 2026. The example and source link are one such hotel, not the full list. Hilton and Loews pages were fetched directly; Marriott, Hyatt, IHG, Wyndham, Choice, Best Western, Accor, Four Seasons and Disney block automated fetches, so their official URLs were confirmed through search results. Brand names follow each company’s own naming; Marriott names match the brand matrix on this site.
